deliverables: Safe discovery/extraction and validation CLI
40 selected sample records and ordered reserves
Source hashes, selection rationale, manifest hash and pending results
acceptance: All selected files exist and decode
Selection is reproducible from saved config and IDs

No source file changed and no provider called

tasks.title: Implement evidence and ward read APIs
deliverables: Read routers for capabilities, samples, cohorts and wards
Manifest-ID audio resolver with range support
Missing-artifact and invalid-ID errors
acceptance: API contract checks pass using labelled examples
Path traversal and arbitrary file access are rejected
Missing results remain null
No benchmark provider call can be triggered through read routes

tasks.title: Build the three browser views
deliverables: Evidence playback and transcript view
Ward table and contribution details
Service view with visible mode, consent, clarification and confirmation
Loading, unavailable and provider-failure UI states
acceptance: Frontend build and interaction checks pass
Keyboard flow is usable and statuses have text
Fixture/cached/replay modes are labelled
No API key or absolute dataset path appears in the bundle

tasks.title: Review pilot samples and write small validation helpers
inputs: Frozen pilot manifest and source metadata
deliverables: One small checker for missing fields, duplicate IDs and invalid paths

Exclusions, meaning-review limits and attribution notes
acceptance: Murtada reviews the helper and any requested substitutions

No metrics or shared selection rules changed in this task

tasks.title: Implement the simulated voice service
inputs: Official ElevenLabs API references in the spec
deliverables: Scribe/TTS adapters and prompt cache
Session router and constrained dialogue state machine
Idempotency, upload limits, local cleanup and failure handling
Scripted replay that refuses arbitrary new audio
acceptance: Mocked tests cover clarification, correction, confirmation, cancellation and provider failure
Repeated request IDs cannot duplicate paid work
No receipt before explicit confirmation
Replay and live processing remain distinct

acceptance: Hisham reviews the proposed journey and expected states
Every script identifies simulation and explicit confirmation

deliverables: Schema-valid production scenario content

Final UAT expectations and presentation outline
acceptance: Content validates against frozen schemas

Unreviewed languages stay disabled

tasks.title: Generate measured results and ward artifacts
deliverables: Dry-run estimate and two-clip live smoke report
40 accounted-for provider results and reproducible corpus metrics
11 ward records with proxy caveats and coverage
Reviewed compact demo artifacts and source attribution
acceptance: Metric edge-case and ward calculation tests pass
Paid work stays within 45 attempts and 1800 submitted seconds
No index appears before the full reviewed pilot succeeds
No fixture contributes to measured summaries
All displayed numbers trace to manifest, settings and source hashes

tasks.title: Integrate and rehearse the foundation release
inputs: All dependency handoffs and reviewed diffs
deliverables: Integrated app and documented clean setup
One reviewed live service smoke and cached fallback
End-to-end checks and UAT evidence
Demo narration linked to measured findings
acceptance: Python checks, frontend build and integration walkthrough pass
No raw dataset, keys or personal recordings enter Git
English and one reviewed additional language complete the service flow
API failure and no-key replay are demonstrated honestly
No deployment or real municipal submission occurs

tasks.title: Independently review release evidence

acceptance: Review covers evidence, index, dialogue, fallback, attribution and accessibility

The reviewer did not author the implementation being reviewed; assign a distinct agent or human
No claims exceed the measured pilot and scenario evidence
